subject: Catalyst Table — co-host dinner: guest curation, NDA handling & escrow logistics
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@brightbridge.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Catalyst Table — co-host dinner: guest curation, NDA handling & escrow logistics

Hi Elena / Tim,

Thanks again for agreeing to co-host the Catalyst Table dinner on Aug 12 in SF. We want this to be low-key but high-impact — ~12 total seats, split 50/50 between BrightBridge and Redwood introductions (founder + product/infra leads). A few practical items we should align on now: 

1) Guest curation: weve drafted an anonymized preview of the guest list (attached: anonymized-guest-preview.csv). Please flag any competitor names you think we should remove or replace.

2) NDA & data handling: BrightBridge requested an NDA flow for a pre-dinner briefing deck. We propose an escrowed NDA (Redwood signs first; BrightBridge sends DocuSign link for their sign-off). Can you confirm whether your legal team needs a redline?

3) Venue contract: The Sable provided a term sheet (attached). Were proposing Redwood serve as the contracting party and BrightBridge cover the sponsorship line item for AV + wine pairing. Is that acceptable?

4) Dietary / accessibility: we plan a private intake link for final RSVP dietary notes — well collect and share only anonymized dietary flags unless theres medical info requiring follow-up.

Next steps: if youre okay with the above, Ben will take point on confirming the venue contract and Marissa will send the DocuSign NDA. Can you confirm timeline constraints from your side by EOD Friday?

Thanks — excited to do this together.

Best,
Rachel
Rachel Kim | Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
mobile: (415) 555-0172

Attachments: BrightBridge_Sponsor_Terms_2027.pdf (5 pages), anonymized-guest-preview.csv (12 rows), Venue_TermSheet_TheSable_0630.docx

From: Elena Morales <elena@brightbridge.com>

Subject: Re: Catalyst Table — co-host dinner: guest curation, NDA handling & escrow logistics

Hi Rachel, Ben —

This looks great and aligned with our expectations. Quick answers: 

- Guest curation: the anonymized preview is perfect. Wed like to replace two names with alternatives (rows 4 & 9) that are less sales-driven; Ill send the replacements in a follow-up.
- NDA: our counsel prefers to review the Redwood redline rather than start with a BrightBridge draft. If you can push the redline by Thursday well aim to return comments by Monday.
- Venue/finance: BrightBridge is fine sponsoring the AV + wine pairing; the term sheet looks standard. We just need a short line item for "sponsorship contribution" in the SOW.
- Timeline: can confirm our Docusign window is fine; would prefer a final guest list no later than Aug 2.

One ask: would Redwood be willing to handle anonymized RSVPs on our behalf? BrightBridge wants the guest privacy maintained until the day of the event. If so, well share a list of the two replacement guests and the preferred order.

Thanks — looking forward to co-hosting.

Best,
Elena
Elena Morales | Head of Strategic Partnerships | BrightBridge Capital

- RSVP handling: Happy to run the anonymized RSVP intake — we will publish a short form under a Redwood URL and only share hashed identifiers with BrightBridge. Laura, can you coordinate the intake page?

Ill aim to have the procurement edits back to the venue by EOD Friday.

Thanks,
Ben
